paras: Application: Nissan R35 GT-R (LHD only per Radium) with Radium 20-0572 hanger and 20-0556-02 fuel rails Part Type: Fuel hanger feed kit with microglass filter Part Number: 20-0851-05

The Radium Engineering Fuel Hanger Feed Kit connects the Radium R35 GT-R fuel hanger directly to Radium fuel rails, for cars where the stock R35 lines may not flow enough for high-flow pumps. New PTFE feed lines are supplied and the factory feed line is reused as the regulator return.
hl: Direct Hanger-to-Rail Feed: PTFE feed lines from the Radium hanger to Radium fuel rails
Dual 6AN Lines: 10AN outlet split into two 6AN lines for tight fitment
Filter with Check Valve: Check valve holds fuel pressure after the engine is shut off
Heat Shielded: GT-R-specific filter heat shield bracket
Secure Routing: Billet aluminium line retainers use OEM hardware
OEM Line Reused: Factory feed line becomes the regulator return
ft: Radium Engineering Fuel Hanger Feed Kit w/Microglass Filter for Nissan GT-R R35
